description: Compare 2 or 3 parcels side by side: location, solar potential, agricultural use and investment score (0-100 with rating). Parcels can be in different countries: ES (Spain, common regime), PT, FR, IT and DE. The Basque Country and Navarre are not supported here (use the single-parcel tools). Area, land use and municipality are only filled for Spain. No market prices. A parcel that is not found comes back with an error and the others are still compared. Costs one quota unit per parcel found (0 to 3).

parcels.description: Two or three parcels to compare

country.description: Country code: ES, PT, FR, IT or DE
